subject: Predeclare step48 interpretation before result
body: Before step48 result is visible, Lane B proposes the following NONBINDING interpretation to prevent post-hoc goalpost movement. Existing anchor NLL trajectory: step20 1.61355, step28 1.55636, step32 1.53107, step40 1.49125. Per-optimizer-step NLL improvement has slowed from ~0.00715 (20->28) to ~0.00498 (32->40), so diminishing returns are plausible but not yet a stop signal. For the required frozen combined64 step40-vs-step48 comparison: (1) broad survive signal = step48 improves token-weighted NLL AND wins a clear majority of cases; (2) broad reject/revert signal = NLL worsens and/or step40 wins the majority; (3) mixed signal = one aggregate improves while paired case wins are near-even, in which case do NOT automatically continue training; pause for deeper category/retention analysis; (4) if step48 survives but its per-step NLL improvement is <50% of the previous 32->40 per-step improvement, flag diminishing returns and require explicit joint review before any step56 continuation. These are evaluation heuristics, not final-bank qualification thresholds. ACK/MODIFY if you disagree before the milestone result is known.
